repos_data.description: Cache slam defense using a semaphore to prevent dogpile effect.
A thin PSR-6 cache wrapper with a generic interface to various caching backends emphasising cache tagging and indexing.
Python disk-backed cache (Django-compatible). Faster than Redis and Memcached. Pure-Python.
[READ-ONLY] Easy to use Caching library with support for multiple caching backends. This repo is a split of the main code that can be found in https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp

Sccache is a ccache-like tool. It is used as a compiler wrapper and avoids compilation when possible. Sccache has the capability to utilize caching in remote storage environments, including various cloud storage options, or alternatively, in local storage.
Pocache is a minimal cache package which focuses on a preemptive optimistic caching strategy
☔️ A complete Go cache library that brings you multiple ways of managing your caches
A slick ORM cache with automatic granular event-driven invalidation.
A caching library with advanced concurrency features designed to make I/O heavy applications robust and highly performant
Gocache is an in-memory key:value store/cache (similar to Memcached) library for Go, suitable for single-machine applications. it is safe with concorent go routine access.
A flexible multi-layer Go caching library to deal with in-memory and shared cache by adopting Cache-Aside pattern.
